q1.text: Cameras are out. Now she's blind.

d1.text: Ray. Why are you helping me?

q3.text: Every time someone runs for the van, they come out of the dark.

d4.text: The engine isn't a rescue. It's a dinner bell.

m1.text: Dev? Your cameras went dark. The van is right there. Just run!

d5.text: Mira, check the left side of the doors. Under the awning.

q4.text: Her camera can't see under the awning.

q5.text: The speakers run on my generator.

d6.text: Mira. Can you play something loud in the parking garage?

d7.text: That's his clipboard. He fell eight floors. So who carried it inside?

end.text: Part seven. Follow, and tell me who carried it in.
